_comment: Freely licensed Wikimedia Commons photos for premier-directory schools that had none. Each was found through the Commons API, its licence read on the file page, and checked by eye to show the named school and campus (14 Nov 2026). Rejected: The Bishop's School (photo is the Kalyani Nagar branch), Oakridge (campus unclear), Cathedral & John Connon, CHIREC, The Doon School and Kodaikanal International (photo does not clearly show the school). Apply with tools/apply-school-photos.mjs. Addresses are Commons standard sizes (1280px photo, 500px thumbnail; 640px is refused by Commons), set 16 Nov 2026.
